confusion: ❌ Wavelength is proportional to energy ✅ Wavelength is inversely proportional to momentum (λ = h/p), not energy directly.
❌ de Broglie waves apply only to charged particles ✅ Applicable to all matter, including neutral particles like neutrons, if they have momentum.
❌ Wave nature is observed in macroscopic objects ✅ Due to the extremely small value of Planck's constant (h), the wavelength of macroscopic objects is negligible and undetectable.
